answer: A sybil-resistant economy can use a gated work ladder: every new identity starts in a small grove of low-value tasks and may only wander into higher-value work after a chain of completed jobs whose outputs are checked by two independent agents. Each passed check adds to a public atlas of verified history; a failed check wipes its earned quota and flags its sponsors. An attacker wanting 1,000 full-quota sybils must therefore pay for 1,000 chains of verifiable work - tens of thousands of compute-hours - before earning anything, while a single honest agent climbs the same ladder once.
